'''Doug Green Amatuer LS Deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Doug Green]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15644">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15644 Amatuer LS Deck], DeckTech (Doug "Guod86" Green, 29 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15644/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15644/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Doug Green]]
* '''Published:''' 29 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Amatuer LS Deck''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor (Light)|Endor-L-endor.gif|label=Endor}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 EL Green LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Please go easy on me.  I know that this deck isn't that good but could you please give me some suggestions.  Thanks.

== Original post ==

'''Amatuer LS Deck'''
* '''Author:''' Doug "Guod86" Green
* '''Published:''' April 29, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Please go easy on me.  I know that this deck isn't that good but could you please give me some suggestions.  Thanks.

=== Strategy ===

Like I said before its a sucky deck, but if you could help at all tell me.  Thanks again. The startagey here is power battle at @#$% few places as possible and it is a long shot but it sometimes getts 80 power if I have all the right cards. I know that it sucks but pleease help me fix it up.
